readings.title: The Law of Vows
readings.subtitle: Obligations of Men and Women
readings.text: [Numbers 30:1] And Mosheh spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the word which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has commanded: [2] “When a man vows a vow to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he does not break his word, he does according to all that comes out of his mouth. [3] “And when a woman vows a vow to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father’s house in her youth, [4] and her father hears <dn>את</dn> her vow and <dn>את</dn> the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father keeps silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she has bound herself shall stand. [5] “But if her father forbids <dn>את</dn> her on the day that he hears, none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> forgives her, because her father forbade her. [6] “And if she at all belongs to a husband, while her vows or a rash utterance of her lips is on her, by which she bound herself, [7] and her husband hears it, and he keeps silent toward her on the day that he hears it, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand. [8] “But if her husband forbids <dn>את</dn> her on the day that he hears it, then he has nullified <dn>את</dn> her vow which was on her, and <dn>את</dn> the rash utterance of her lips by which she bound herself. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> forgives her. [9] “But any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, stands against her. [10] “And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath, [11] and her husband heard it, and kept silent toward her and did not forbid her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself shall stand. [12] “But if her husband clearly nullified <dn>את</dn> them on the day he heard them, then any utterance from her lips concerning her vows or concerning her agreement does not stand. Her husband has nullified <dn>את</dn> them, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> forgives her. [13] “Every vow and every binding oath to afflict the being, her husband establishes it, or her husband nullifies it. [14] “But if her husband keeps silent toward her from day to day, then he establishes <dn>את</dn> all her vows or <dn>את</dn> all her agreements which are on her. He establishes <dn>את</dn> them because he kept silent toward her on the day that he heard them. [15] “But if he nullifies <dn>את</dn> them after he has heard them, then he shall bear <dn>את</dn> her crookedness.” [16] These are the laws which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father’s house.

readings.title: Vengeance on Midian
readings.subtitle: The War and the End of Balaam
readings.text: [Numbers 31:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Take vengeance for the children of Israel on the Miḏyanites. After that you are to be gathered to your people.”</dq> [3] And Mosheh spoke to the people, saying, “Arm some of yourselves for the campaign, and let them go against Miḏyan to take vengeance for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on Miḏyan. [4] “Send a thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel for the campaign.” [5] So there were supplied from the thousands of Israel a thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for the campaign. [6] And Mosheh sent <dn>את</dn> them for the campaign, a thousand from each tribe, them and <dn>את</dn> Pineḥas son of El’azar the priest for the campaign, with the set-apart utensils and the trumpets for sounding in his hand. [7] And they fought against Miḏyan, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, and killed <dn>את</dn> every male. [8] And they killed <dn>את</dn> the sovereigns of Miḏyan with the rest of those who were killed: <dn>את</dn> Ewî, and <dn>את</dn> Reqem, and <dn>את</dn> Tsur, and <dn>את</dn> Ḥur, and <dn>את</dn> Reḇa, the five sovereigns of Miḏyan. And they killed <dn>את</dn> Bil’am son of Be’or with the sword. [9] And the children of Israel took <dn>את</dn> all the women of Miḏyan captive, with <dn>את</dn> their little ones, and took as spoil <dn>את</dn> all their livestock, and <dn>את</dn> all their possessions. [10] And they burned with fire <dn>את</dn> all the cities where they dwelt, and <dn>את</dn> all their settlements. [11] And they took <dn>את</dn> all the spoil and <dn>את</dn> all the booty, of man and of beast. [12] And they brought <dn>את</dn> the captives, and <dn>את</dn> the booty, and <dn>את</dn> the spoil to Mosheh, and to El’azar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ, which are by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo.

readings.title: Purification of the Army
readings.subtitle: Cleansing of the Spoils and the Captives
readings.text: [Numbers 31:13] And Mosheh, and El’azar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation, went to meet them outside the camp. [14] But Mosheh was wroth with the officers of the army, with the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, who had come from the campaign. [15] And Mosheh said to them, “Have you kept all the women alive? [16] “See, they are the ones who caused the children of Israel, through the word of Bil’am, to trespass against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the matter of Pe’or, and there was a plague among the congregation of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [17] “And now, kill <dn>את</dn> every male among the little ones, and kill <dn>את</dn> every woman who has known a man by lying with him. [18] “But keep alive for yourselves all the female children who have not known a man by lying with him. [19] “And as for you, camp outside the camp seven days. Whoever has killed any being, and whoever has touched any slain, cleanse yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day. [20] “And cleanse <dn>את</dn> every garment, and <dn>את</dn> every object of leather, and <dn>את</dn> all work of goats’ hair, and <dn>את</dn> every object of wood.” [21] And El’azar the priest said to the men of battle who had gone to the campaign, “This is the law of the Torah which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh: [22] “Only <dn>את</dn> the gold, and <dn>את</dn> the silver, <dn>את</dn> the bronze, <dn>את</dn> the iron, <dn>את</dn> the tin, and <dn>את</dn> the lead, [23] every object that passes through fire, you put through the fire, and it shall be clean; only, let it be cleansed with the water of separation. And whatever does not pass through fire you pass through water. [24] “And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and be clean, and afterwards come into the camp.”

readings.title: Division of the Spoil
readings.subtitle: Distribution of Livestock and Captives
readings.text: [Numbers 31:25] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [26] <dq>“Count <dn>את</dn> the loot that was taken, of man and of beast, you and El’azar the priest and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the congregation.</dq> [27] <dq>“And you shall divide <dn>את</dn> the booty into two, between those who began the fight who went out to the campaign, and all the congregation.</dq> [28] <dq>“And levy a tax for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on the men of battle who went out to the campaign: one being out of five hundred, of the men, and of the cattle, and of the donkeys, and of the sheep.</dq> [29] <dq>“Take it from their half, and give it to El’azar the priest as a contribution to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [30] <dq>“And from the children of Israel’s half you take one of every fifty, of the men, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the sheep, of all the livestock, and give <dn>את</dn> them to the Lĕwites guarding the duty of the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.”</dq> [31] And Mosheh and El’azar the priest did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [32] And the booty, the rest of the spoil which the men of battle had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep, [33] and seventy-two thousand cattle, [34] and sixty-one thousand donkeys, [35] and thirty-two thousand beings in all, of women who had not known a man by lying with him. [36] And the half, the portion of those who went out to the campaign, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep; [37] and the tax for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five. [38] And the cattle were thirty-six thousand, and the tax for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was seventy-two. [39] And the donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tax for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was sixty-one. [40] And the beings were sixteen thousand, and the tax for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was thirty-two beings. [41] So Mosheh gave <dn>את</dn> the tax, which was <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>’s contribution, to El’azar the priest, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [42] And from the children of Israel’s half, which Mosheh divided from the men who fought – [43] now the congregation’s half was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep, [44] and thirty-six thousand cattle, [45] and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys, [46] and sixteen thousand beings – [47] then Mosheh took <dn>את</dn> one of every fifty, of man and of beast, from the children of Israel’s half, and gave <dn>את</dn> them to the Lĕwites guarding the duty of the Dwelling Place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.

readings.title: The Voluntary Offering
readings.subtitle: The Officers' Atonement
readings.text: [Numbers 31:48] And the officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, came near to Mosheh, [49] and they said to Mosheh, “Your servants have taken <dn>את</dn> a census of the men of battle who are under our command, and not a man of us is missing. [50] “So we have brought <dn>את</dn> an offering for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, what every man found: objects of gold, ornaments for the arm and bracelets, signet rings and earrings and necklaces, to make atonement for our beings before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [51] And Mosheh and El’azar the priest took <dn>את</dn> the gold from them, <dn>את</dn> all the finished objects. [52] And all the gold of the contribution that they presented to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty sheqels. [53] The men of battle had taken spoil, every man for himself. [54] And Mosheh and El’azar the priest took <dn>את</dn> the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought <dn>את</dn> it into the Tent of Appointment as a remembrance for the children of Israel before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
